subject: Private hosting discovery — network & residency recap
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lina Morales <lina.morales@medsynchealth.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medsynchealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private hosting discovery — network & residency recap

Hi Lina / Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call with the MedSync infra and security leads so we have alignment and clear next steps. I’ve kept this intentionally short — please reply with corrections.

Summary of pain & goals
- Regulatory driver: PHI residency requirement for some datasets (California + Fed programs). Customer legal wants clear air-gap / on-prem / VPC residency options documented.
- Risk: no external egress of raw PHI allowed; only encrypted tokenized outputs may flow out under strict controls.
- Ops: limited network team bandwidth — need a predictable installation checklist and a short pilot plan.

Technical constraints we captured
- Deployment: customer prefers VPC-hosted private control plane with a small on-prem inference cluster (NVIDIA A10s) behind their firewall.
- Connectivity: site-to-site VPN or dedicated AWS Direct Connect; static outbound IPs required for allowlisting with partner systems.
- Ports: only outbound TCP 443 allowed; no inbound NAT to inference nodes.
- DNS/proxy: traffic must traverse their corporate proxy for outbound monitoring; we need to validate TLS passthrough approach.
- Logs & SIEM: the security team requires streaming audit logs (syslog/Splunk) and timeframe for retention (7 years for audit artifacts).
- Key management: customer will use their KMS/HSM; Redwood must support customer-managed keys and offline key rotations.

Action items (owner — due)
1) Hannah — send a short network diagram and a minimal on-prem checklist for their infra team to review (attached) — due 2026-11-30 EOD.
2) Karthik — confirm proxy/TLS passthrough approach and whether NAT-less egress is supported with our runtime — due 2026-12-03.
3) Ben — provide draft pricing for a 3-month pilot (small reserved pool + support hours) — due 2026-12-04.
4) Carlos / Lina — share the security questionnaire highlights (SOC audit scope, specific COCs) and an example PHI data flow diagram if available — due 2026-12-02.

Attachments: medsync-network-draft.pdf (sketch with peering options), redwood-onprem-checklist.xlsx (install pre-reqs).

Proposed next touchpoints
- Tech deep-dive with your network/security folks (45 minutes) — proposed slots: Thu 12/3 10:00-10:45 PT or Fri 12/4 09:00-09:45 PT. Please indicate what works.

If this matches your understanding, I’ll book the deep-dive and loop in Karthik for the TLS discussion.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medsynchealth.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private hosting discovery — network & residency recap

Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns well with what our security team logged during the call. A few clarifications / notes from our side: 

- PHI flow: we cannot allow raw PHI to leave the VPC. Any external calls must be to tokenized records only. I attached a simple PHI flow diagram (medsync-phi-flow.png) that shows our current ingestion -> tokenization -> analytics split.
- Pilot timeline: internal approval window is tight; we are pushing to start a small pilot in early Q1 (target week of 2027-01-10). That said, security will need a short checklist and a SOC/Security summary to greenlight the PoC.
- Proxy & egress: our proxy team will require a sample of TLS traffic patterns (SNI headers, cert pinning behavior) so they can simulate and allowlist.

I'll coordinate with Lina to get the questionnaire highlights and send those by 2026-12-02 as you requested. For the pilot, Ben’s pricing durability will be an important input to our procurement team.

Thanks again — I can do Thu 12/3 10:00 PT for the deep-dive.

Carlos Rivera
Director of Infrastructure | MedSync Health
c.rivera@medsynchealth.com | +1 (650) 555-2299

3) I’ll schedule the tech deep-dive for Thu 12/3 10:00 PT and include an agenda: (a) network topology & proxy validation (b) key management options (c) pilot deployment checklist.
